description.p: Black-Bag is a password manager for a single local vault, sealed with Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305 and recoverable through hybrid post-quantum recipients (X25519 combined with ML-KEM-1024).

This application is the deck: it renders the vault and drives the black-bag engine as a child process. It holds no key material, derives no key, and performs no cryptography of its own. A passphrase crosses to the engine on standard input and never in an argument vector. Record metadata is shown freely; secret bytes are fetched only when you explicitly copy or reveal one, and a reveal clears itself on a visible countdown.

Every posture on screen is the engine's own report, carried through verbatim. When the engine cannot vouch for something the deck draws it as unknown rather than filling in a pass, and a status older than the stale threshold desaturates instead of asserting a state it cannot stand behind.
First release of the standalone deck.
